subject.title: feat: unify Claude Code / Codex session catalogs into native session UX

question: Should OpenClaw retain the permanent session-catalog Plugin SDK and zero-config operator catalog direction represented by this PR and current main?
rationale: The external plugin contract and activation semantics are durable product decisions that cannot be approved implicitly by correctness tests or code review.

options.title: Retain and finish
options.body: Keep the generic SDK and native UX, preserve current-main repairs, fix the remaining blockers, and require live proof.

options.title: Narrow the public API
options.body: Keep native catalog UX but defer or restrict the external Plugin SDK contract until broader provider demand is established.

options.title: Revert the direction
options.body: Return to plugin-specific catalogs if maintainers do not want the permanent contract or zero-config activation.

recommendation.title: Retain and finish
recommendation.body: Keep the generic SDK and native UX, preserve current-main repairs, fix the remaining blockers, and require live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged feature history and adjacent session UI work make this person the strongest available product-direction owner.
